question: Should QQBot keep `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a supported data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending it?
rationale: Current main advertises `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in diagnostics, but the data helper is now legacy-adjacent storage and a new env-controlled root affects compatibility and path-security boundaries.

options.title: Support a validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require redacted real diagnostic proof before merge.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the diagnostic guidance and close the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support a validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, safe `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require redacted real diagnostic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot SQLite storage migration work makes this the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
